consult.title: Help choosing a build
consult.body: Tell us what you'll use the PC for and your budget, and we'll recommend a build and explain why we picked each part.
steps: You send us the use and budget
We send one or two recommendations
You choose, and we adjust if you like

build.title: Assembly
build.body: Whether the parts come from us or from you, we assemble the PC, tidy the cables, install Windows and drivers, and hand it over ready. If a part should be swapped, we suggest an alternative.

Report with the result and photos
